evidence.observation: BTC has a completed sharp drop through the four-hour rising line and rebound to a prior high/50-percent Fibonacci area. Speaker calls another touch of the line and a 61.8-percent short opportunity future possibilities, says immediate bearish continuation was weak, and gives no new short order.

For LINK, speaker explicitly says one trend-line break does not make the market bearish while higher highs/lows remain; the line can be redrawn, so raw fixed-pivot line crossing is not his full direction rule.
For SOL, breakout participation should clear prior highs/lows and exit the larger box; a narrow triangle-line break alone leaves too little room and is not enough to take the long.
DOGE discussion combines declining line and horizontal levels with prospective short locations and stop above prior high; no confirmed new short at an observed line retest is established.

UNI first break/retest and prior short are retrospective remarks; current advice is to hold an existing long or consider a future deep pullback, without an identified new order at this video decision.
